score_kind: heuristic visual similarity (not a calibrated probability)
verdict: The render is geometrically faithful: circle, diameter AB, the two chords PC and PD, and all six labels sit where they do in the original. Remaining differences are stroke weight and point-marker styling.

figure_type.original: Circle with horizontal diameter AB, centre O, point P on AB between O and B, chords PC and PD meeting at P with C and D on the upper arc
figure_type.render: Circle with horizontal diameter AB, centre O, point P on AB between O and B, chords PC and PD meeting at P with C and D on the upper arc

issues.description: The diameter AB is drawn at the same weight as the circle and chords (1.7pt). In the original it is visibly thinner than the circle arc, so the render's AB is too heavy.
issues.suggestion: Draw the AB segment with a thinner line width (for example 0.8-1pt) while keeping the circle and PC/PD at about 1.7pt.

issues.description: The centre O is a bold filled dot in the original, but the render draws it as a small dot.
issues.suggestion: Increase the radius of the fill at O to match the original (roughly the size of the P marker), or keep it as is if small-dot styling is preferred.

issues.description: The render puts filled dots at A and B where the original has only the line ending on the circle with no visible marker.
issues.suggestion: Remove the fill for A and B, or leave them if the dots are judged harmless for the figure.
